hero.p1: Fire, rhythm and grilling together in a relaxed, late-night atmosphere. We care about great service and vibes, but here you take the tongs — because the biggest fun is grilling together.
hero.p2: We're not a classic restaurant. At the centre of the venue stands a large grill where our guests prepare their own steaks, cheeses, sausages and whatever they fancy. No stress, no pretence — just good vibes and food made on your own terms. In the atmospheric Kazimierz district we welcome you every night until 2:00 AM. When other places close up, the best part of the evening is just beginning here.
hero.p3: The Landmark Supper Club is all about good vibes, great drinks, cold beer, live concerts and events — a meeting place for those who don't like to end the night too early. Come join us by the fire. We're open EVERY DAY until 2:00 AM.
